# Feature Specification: Personal Blog


    ## Summary
    A single-author blog: write posts in Markdown, publish them, list them by date.
    No comments, no multi-tenancy, no search.

    ## Requirements
    - **FR-001**: An author MUST be able to create a post with a title and Markdown body.
    - **FR-002**: An author MUST be able to publish and unpublish a post.
    - **FR-003**: Visitors MUST see published posts listed newest first.
    - **FR-004**: Post slugs MUST be unique and derived from the title.

    ## Out of Scope
    Comments, search, multiple authors, scheduled publishing.
